title: Recognising Eczema as a Chronic Disease
what_it_is: Recognising Eczema as a Chronic Disease

sections.label: Eczema prevalence in Singapore
sections.summary: Eczema affects over 31 million Americans and an estimated 20% of children and 11% of adults in Singapore, with 14,000 new National Skin Centre cases in the year ending 31 March 2023 versus 9,406 in 2008.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: This chronic inflammatory skin condition affects more than 31 million Americans.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: And in Singapore, it is estimated to affect 20% of children and 11% of adults.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: At the National Skin Centre, 14,000 new eczema cases were seen in the year ending 31 March 2023 versus 9,406 cases in 2008.

sections.label: Eczema and mental health symptoms
sections.summary: Poor sleep hampers emotion regulation, increasing depression vulnerability, and a 2024 study reported 72% of people with eczema have adverse mental health symptoms one to 10 days monthly, 17% more than 11 days.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: Poor sleep creates difficulties in regulating emotions that, in turn, leave a person vulnerable to depression.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: There was a study presented at the 2024 American College of Allergy, Asthma and Immunology Annual Scientific Meeting, where it was reported that 72% of people with eczema have adverse mental health symptoms for one to 10 days a month, with 17% having symptoms for more than 11 days per month.

sections.label: Eczema cost per child
sections.summary: In Singapore, the average annual cost per child with eczema was estimated at US$7,943 based on 2017 prices.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: In Singapore, the average annual cost per child with eczema was estimated at US$7,943 based on 2017 prices.

sections.label: Dupilumab approval and effectiveness
sections.summary: Dupilumab is a safe and effective treatment approved in Singapore for children aged six months and older, with around 60% of people seeing at least 75% improvement.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: Dupilumab is a safe and effective treatment that has been approved in Singapore for children aged six months and older, and around 60% of people will see at least a 75% improvement in their condition.

sections.label: Dupilumab injection cost
sections.summary: Each injection costs almost $1,000 per injection every fortnight, or $2,000 per month, at public healthcare institutions such as the National Skin Centre.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: Each injection costing almost $1,000 per injection every fortnight, or $2,000 per month, at public healthcare institutions, such as the National Skin Centre.

sections.label: Subsidised drugs and biologics
sections.summary: The passage calls for including other biologics such as Dupilumab in the subsidised drug list, noting the Drug Advisory Committee recommended only Abrocitinib, a JAK inhibitor, due to a cost-minimisation approach as it is least costly.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: First, inclusion of other biologics, such as Dupilumab, into list of subsidised drugs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: I understand the Drug Advisory Committee (DAC) has recommended only Abrocitinib, a JAK inhibitor, to be on the list of subsidised drugs because of the cost-minimisation approach, given that Abrocitinib is least costly.

sections.label: MediSave 700 for eczema
sections.summary: Eczema patients can get up to $700 of MediSave coverage per year under the MediSave 700 scheme.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: Eczema patients can also find financial relief for the hefty out-of-pocket payments, with up to $700 of MediSave coverage per year under the MediSave 700 scheme.

sections.label: Dupilumab MAF request
sections.summary: A request was made for the Ministry to include Dupilumab under the Medication Assistance Fund.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: Due to the high cost of newer treatments for moderate-to-severe eczema, I would like to request that the Ministry include Dupilumab under the Medication Assistance Fund (MAF).

sections.label: CAC eczema CDMP decision
sections.summary: In 2020, the CAC decided not to include eczema under CDMP.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: In 2020, the CAC had decided not to include eczema under CDMP.

sections.label: CAC review of eczema
sections.summary: Once guidelines are established, the CAC will review whether eczema can be included in the CDMP.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Once these guidelines have been established, the CAC will review if eczema can be included into the CDMP.

sections.label: Dupilumab subsidy not recommended
sections.summary: Dupilumab was not recommended for subsidy as its benefits do not justify its costs at the proposed price.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Dupilumab, an injectable, was not recommended for subsidy, as its benefits do not justify its costs, at the current price proposed by the manufacturer.

sections.label: MediFund help and drug review
sections.summary: Patients may approach medical social workers for MediFund assistance, and the subsidised drug list will be regularly reviewed.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: So, if patients face issues affording Dupilumab, they may approach medical social workers at our public healthcare institutions to apply for financial assistance through MediFund.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: We will continue to regularly review the list of subsidised drugs to ensure that the list stays relevant to changes in our local population needs, medical practice and the evidence on clinical and cost effectiveness.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: No Singaporean will be denied access to appropriate healthcare due to an inability to pay.
